Select molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key, publication provenance (PubMed ID or DOI), assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism for IC50 activities against human TRPV1 (CHEMBL4794). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, then docs via assays.doc_id, then compound_structures. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4794 and standard_type IC50. Coalesce DOI and PubMed ID into pubmed_id_or_doi. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
